item.title: I installed glance - A nice Dashboard
item.description: Ok so today I installed Glance - A nice self-hosted dashboard application , I use it to get my news from hacker news , the weather and also an overview of my self hosted services. It looks cool , its light weight plus its super customizable ,So Its a really satisfying application to self host , Thank you to my friend Vihas for helping me build this and telling me about all these I also added a proxy + pihole setup which I can use to convert 127.0.0.1:4533 into navidrome.home , I also got that idea from Vihas heres his blog Vihas Blog !
